Fantasy - W, X, Y, Z cup, each breast could fill its own lifebuoy, as big as giant pumpkins.

entries.name: x06 scale milk volume
entries.content:
The milk volume scale from smallest to largest:
None - she doesn't produce breast milk yet.
Average - each breast stores a quarter cup to a half cup of milk; this is the average amount for a woman.
Sizable - each breast stores a half cup to a full cup of milk; it would take a couple women to produce this much.
Large - each breast stores a full cup to a pint of milk; it would take five women to produce this much.
Huge - each breast stores a quart or two of milk; it would take ten women to produce this much.
Massive - each breast stores a gallon or two of milk; it would take thirty women to produce this much.
Gigantic - each breast stores many gallons of milk; it would take more than a hundred women to produce this much.

entries.name: x07 scale nipple shape
entries.content:
The nipple shape scale from smallest to largest:
Small - the size of a pushpin, areola 1-inch diameter like a silver dollar, pink.
Average - the size of a skittle, areola 1.5-inch diameter like a pepperoni slice, pink.
Sizable - the size of a blueberry, areola 2-inch diameter like a soda can lid, pink.
Large - the size of a razzberry, areola 3-inch diameter like a salami slice, pink.
Huge - the size of a strawberry, areola 4-inch diameter like a drink coaster, pink.
Massive - the size of a short, thick penis, areola 5-inch diameter like a pancake, pink.
